_comment: Curated priority sites for the monthly time-series screenshot archive (see the tracking issue + reports/capture-pipeline.md). Each capture is stored dated under r2:shko-public/screenshots/<name>/<ts>.{png,thumb.jpg,html,txt,json} and NEVER overwritten. tier 0 = cooperative (renders anywhere); tier 1 = bot-walled/JS-challenge (needs the stealth browser; some need a residential IP). Add a site: give it a unique name, url, title, collection, tier, and residential_only if a datacenter IP can't reach it (e.g. a Cloudflare managed challenge).
